newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n, one week rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n, one week rates fall.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in a liquid private sector market on Thursday to between seven and 8-3/4 percent from Wednesday's range of 8-1/4 and nine percent, bankers said.
The market is traditionally liquid on the last day of the working week.
One-week rates also fell to between 7-3/4 and 8-1/2 percent from 8-1/2 and 9-1/4 percent on Wednesday, the bankers said.
They said that public-sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
